extensionDescription.message: Adds furigana above Japanese kanji on web pages. Works fully offline with no data collection or internet requests.

popupSiteHint.message: This page is not a normal website.

optionsTagline.message: Fully offline Japanese furigana for web pages.

optionsLanguageHint.message: Choose the extension's interface language. Automatic follows your browser's language.

optionsThemeHint.message: Dark mode for the extension's interface. Automatic follows your browser or operating system.

optionsExcludedHint.message: Furigana is not added on these sites. Hostnames only, e.g. example.com.

optionsPrivacyBody.message: Japanese text is processed locally on your device and is never transmitted by this extension. No network requests, no analytics, no telemetry. Readings are cached in memory only; any reading corrections you make are stored locally in this extension's own storage on your device.

optionsCorrection.message: Let me correct readings by clicking the furigana
